# Register the benchmark component.
# esp-dl is pulled via idf_component.yml; monitor_params.c is generated by code/export_monitor.py.
# NOTE: if you call the esp-dl C++ API directly from qsentry_bench, rename it to .cpp (or wrap the
# esp-dl calls in a small .cpp and keep this file C). monitor_params.c is plain C (extern const).
idf_component_register(
    SRCS "qsentry_bench.cpp" "monitor_params.c" "testset.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES driver esp_timer esp-dl
    EMBED_FILES "model/model.espdl"
)
